title: Dart Null Safety: No More Sneaky Nulls

scenes.line1: Can variables be null by default?
scenes.say: Ever had an app crash because something was unexpectedly empty? Can variables in Dart be null by default? Let's find out.

scenes.label: Nullable
scenes.sub: Variables can't be null unless you add a question mark.
scenes.say: In Dart, variables can't be empty unless you mark them as nullable with a question mark. This catches mistakes early.
Here, name can be empty because it's marked as nullable. But age can't, so trying to set age to empty throws a compile-time error.

scenes.question: Can all variables be null in Dart?
scenes.right: No, only variables marked as nullable with a question mark can be null.
scenes.say: Watch out! Not every variable can be empty in Dart. Only those you explicitly mark as nullable can hold a null value.
